status: experimental source-relative acoustic transformations; not a trained Japanese voice or universal IPA realization
parameter_provenance: Dimensionless warp anchors, blend weights and contact settings are explicit Verdant prototype parameters. They are not measurements of Japanese child speech and are not constants taken from a paper.

vowel_recipes.phonetic_intent: Raise the middle portion of the source envelope while preserving its low resonance and upper spectrum. This is a centralization candidate; it does not recover lip compression or establish a target F2.
Lower the source's low-resonance neighborhood toward a closer vowel while retaining its higher envelope. The setting is a prototype relative adjustment, not an exact Japanese formant target.

tap.phonetic_intent: Retain the English tap model and add at most one short, smooth constriction only if the rendered source lacks a clear energy dip. This does not assert that every Japanese rhotic is a canonical alveolar tap.

palatalization.phonetic_intent: Spread the already allocated palatal helper's own spectral gesture into the base consonant and following vowel. No phone or duration is added; a separate /j/ approximation is not claimed to be a fully recovered palatal consonant.
